moments.title: I'm A Celebrity... Get Me Out Of Here! Returns
moments.blurb: The new series of I'm A Celebrity... Get Me Out of Here! returns on Monday, November 16, at 9pm on ITV1, STV, and ITVX, with Ant and Dec presenting live from the Australian jungle.

angles.name: Anticipation

moments.title: England Men's Football In Action
moments.blurb: England's men's team plays Croatia at Wembley Stadium today, Thursday, November 12, at 7:45pm GMT in the UEFA Nations League, before an away fixture against Spain on Sunday, November 15, in Madrid.

angles.name: Tonight's Game

angles.copy: Harry Kane is set to earn his record-breaking 126th cap for England tonight against Croatia. A true legend! Will he mark it with a goal?

angles.name: Upcoming Fixture
angles.copy: After tonight's home game, England are off to Madrid to face Spain on Sunday. Two massive Nations League clashes in one week!
